code: CudaMonSession(   device_metrics = data.frame(),   compute_processes = data.frame(),   events = data.frame(),   paths = list(),   metadata = list() )

title: Construct a CudaMon session object — CudaMonSession
text: device_metrics Data frame GPU device-level samples. Expected columns include: timestamp Sample timestamp UTC. sampler_pid Root process identifier tracked sampler. device_index Zero-based GPU device index. gpu_utilization_pct Percent sampling interval least one kernel executing GPU. activity ratio, measure saturated GPU cores . memory_utilization_pct Percent sampling interval global device memory read written . memory-controller activity, fraction GPU memory allocated. temperature_c GPU temperature degrees Celsius. power_usage_mw Instantaneous board power draw milliwatts. memory_used_bytes Bytes device memory currently allocated. memory_total_bytes Total bytes device memory available. compute_processes Data frame GPU process-level samples. Expected columns include: timestamp Sample timestamp UTC. sampler_pid Root process identifier tracked sampler. device_index Zero-based GPU device index. pid Process identifier reported NVML using GPU. tracked_pid Tracked process identifier filtering requested root process , optionally, descendants. is_root_pid Whether tracked_pid root process passed sampler. used_gpu_memory_bytes Bytes GPU memory allocated process sampled device, reported NVML. gpu_instance_id MIG GPU instance identifier, NA apply reported. compute_instance_id MIG compute instance identifier, NA apply reported. events Data frame event markers recorded sampling. paths Named list output paths. metadata Named list session metadata.

title: Start sampling NVML metrics to CSV files — cm_start
text: period Sampling interval seconds. pid Root process identifier, defaults current R session PID. include_descendants Whether include child processes pid. device_index Optional integer GPU index. NULL, query devices. log Optional log file written background sampler process. path_prefix Optional output path prefix. NULL, unique prefix generated automatically. Three files created: *_device_metrics.csv, *_compute_processes.csv, *_events.csv.
